objective: Mean over complete training units of their fresh-row mean squared corrected-count error; exclude exactly the initialization row; no filtering or target interpolation.
optimizer: Deterministic bounded Nelder-Mead in normalized coordinates, clipping candidates to declared bounds; one fixed engineering-prior start per baseline; no validation-driven restarts.
map_initialization: Median fresh last100ms plateau samples at each knot across training units only; median fresh training samples nearest knot if no plateau.

baselines.static: Three optimized map knots, all dynamics/hysteresis disabled
baselines.lag: Three optimized map knots plus one common tau, no delay/backlash/rate limit
baselines.full: Three map knots, play backlash, common delay, directional tau and directional rate limits
